outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women in a tertiary center, with 154 PWWE matched 1:3 with a control group (n=462)
finding: While the risk of postpartum hemorrhage was not increased in PWWE, they experienced higher rates of Cesarean delivery and fetal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in pregnant women with epilepsy compared to the control group.
